summary.oneLiner: An integrated gold and silver platform in India serving businesses and consumers across 24 states as of March 31, 2026, spanning procurement and refining, bullion trading, digital gold offerings, jewellery manufacturing, international sales and facilitation of gold-backed financial services.
summary.business: Augmont Enterprises operates two business verticals through distinct online platforms complemented by a physical distribution network: enterprise and international sales through the 'Augmont SPOT' electronic over-the-counter delivery-based bullion platform (operational since 2012, over 5,223 registered members as of March 31, 2026), and consumer-focused offerings through the 'Augmont Gold For All' platform launched in Fiscal 2021.
